detailed_description: The Canvas Drawing tool provides a simple browser-side drawing surface backed by an HTML canvas. You can choose from preset colors or a custom color picker, adjust the brush size from 1 to 50, switch between brush and eraser modes, clear the canvas, and download the current drawing as a PNG file. The canvas has a fixed 800 by 500 drawing area with a dark background and uses basic pointer drawing with round line caps. It does not offer custom canvas dimensions, layers, path smoothing, opacity or blend modes, raw pixel processing, SVG export, serialization, collaboration workflows, or WebAssembly acceleration.
usage_steps: Choose a preset color or use the color picker.
Adjust the brush size slider from 1 to 50.
Draw on the canvas with the pointer.
Clear the canvas or download the current drawing as a PNG file.
usage_examples: Sketch a quick idea directly on the browser canvas.
Draw a simple annotation or rough diagram and download it as a PNG.
Try different brush sizes and colors while making a small doodle.
Use the eraser and clear controls while experimenting with canvas drawing.
